LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupButtonDesc: Opens the setup pages again: a page for each active D'thorga mod, what it does, and the few choices worth making before a colony.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupWelcome:
These pages set up the D'thorga mods you have active, one page each: what the mod does, what it changes in other mods, and the few choices worth making before you start a colony.

On each page, pick a preset, or tick "Show each setting" to choose one by one. Choices that need a restart are gathered at the end.

Every choice here is also in Options > Mod settings, where you can change it later. "Skip setup" keeps your settings as they are.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupWelcomeAgain: Since you last saw these pages, the ones below are new or have changed. Everything else stays as you set it.\n\nEvery choice here is also in Options > Mod settings. "Skip setup" keeps your settings as they are.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupOtherMods: What it changes in other mods:
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupPresets: How do you want to play?
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupShowEachDesc: Shows every setting the presets set, so you can choose each one yourself.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupNoSettings: Nothing to choose here: this page only introduces the mod.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupGuideDesc: Opens this mod's chapter of the player guide in your web browser.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupNoChanges: Nothing changed: your settings stay as they were.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupRestartNote: Some of these take effect after a restart: the game asks when you press Finish.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupFinishText: Open these pages again at any time from Options > Mod settings > D'thorga Framework, General page: "Setup and introduction". Every setting is there too, with a search box.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SetupSkipDesc: Close without changing anything: any setting changed on these pages goes back to what it was. These pages open again only when one is new or has changed.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SoundVehiclesElsewhere: Whether vehicle sounds also play on other mods' vehicles is set in D'thorga Vehicle Systems, on its "Display, sound and stories" page.
